messages.guide.title: Notices
messages.guide.intro.title: Hello
messages.guide.intro:
Hello. I’m Enomoto from Yohaku, a small software publisher.
I came across the screen you’re building and wanted to get in touch. When it’s ready, would you let us sell it?
messages.guide.instructions.title: Tools for building a screen
messages.guide.instructions:
Thank you. First, you’ll need a tool for building screens.
Work through “Upgrades” below, and you’ll be able to build that tool too. There’s no rush.
messages.guide.tool.title: About Tessera
messages.guide.tool:
It looks like you can build a tool now. Tessera is an app for designing screen parts.
Once you build it, this screen will become a document you can edit inside Tessera.
messages.guide.hint.title: What to build next
messages.guide.hint: Take a look at “Upgrades” below. More auto cursors will keep the work moving while you rest your hands.

messages.k.guide.entered: Your screen is here now. The auto cursors are still at work.
messages.k.guide.draw:
First, I’d like a folder icon.
Place dots on the faint template cells to turn them into pixels.
messages.k.guide.complete: It’s drawn. Use “Export” at the top right to save the finished work.
messages.k.guide.export:
Exporting earns tokens. Think of them as our payment for your parts.
Pixels build the screen’s contents; tokens make Tessera itself more useful.
messages.k.guide.extensions:
You can spend tokens here. Start with whichever you like.
If you’re unsure, Fill or Draw symmetrically will make drawing easier.
messages.k.guide.name: Now that you’ve built an input field, may I ask your name?
messages.k.guide.wall:
We’ve reached a limit. A desktop needs 256 colors, but this screen has 16.
Shall we release what you’ve made as prototype v0.1? The sales can pay for better screen performance.
messages.k.guide.hint: Check “Export” at the top right for finished work. Place your parts on the home screen to use them.

messages.intro.note:
Production notes.txt

This screen is made of pixels.
Press the button to create one pixel.
Collect pixels to build Border, Color, and Font.
Everything I build becomes part of this screen.

Goal: Finish building this screen and release it as v1.0.
Someday, I want to be able to make anything with this one screen.
messages.release.confirm.title: Release the prototype
messages.release.confirm:
Everything is ready. The shipped version belongs to your customers, so you will rebuild the next version from scratch for the improved hardware.
You will give up your pixels, parts, and layout. Plugins, hardware, and your icons (as templates) will remain.
Finally, please choose a name for your product.
messages.release.needRevenue: 256 colors costs {dollars} dollars. Build a little more before shipping.
messages.release.sales.title: First sales
messages.release.sales:
The first day sold better than I expected. Thank you.
You can improve the screen’s performance with this revenue. Start with more colors: 256 colors can display a desktop.
messages.guide.return.title: The next version
messages.guide.return:
Welcome back. You are starting from the first screen, but there are many more colors this time.
Customers have told us they want to use other apps alongside it. Let’s make v1.0 a version that works as a desktop.
